findings.impact: Neither raw file contains a target hierarchy or a single activity record, so the measurement cannot be annotated, used for power or energy, or cited. The M2176 parser correctly blocks publication at the first diagnostic SAIF.
findings.likely_cause: The M2176 UCLI script omits the explicit power -gate_level policy required for SystemVerilog and multidimensional-array monitoring. The generic default-monitoring header reports elapsed duration but does not establish that any eligible object was selected.
findings.remediation: Do not retry M2178. Under fresh M2185 source identity, create a new additive UCLI file whose only protocol change is `power -gate_level all mda sv` before the existing `power <scope>` and `power -enable`; bind and independently hammer that new source before any future M2187 one-shot.

failure_isolation.first_failing_gate: diagnostic prehistory SAIF target INSTANCE count

dut_activity_nonexistent.reason: The complete functional ledger passes with 29,472 products, and a prior same-M2018 60,876 ns run produced 93,971 SAIF records when explicit gate-level monitoring was enabled.

monitoring_policy_missing.reason: The installed official UCLI flow places power -gate_level before region selection and enable; M2178 omits it, both empty files identify only default monitoring, and old working runs explicitly enable all/mda/sv.

scope_command_ineffective.reason: The fully qualified elaborated DUT path appears in both region selection and report commands with no UCLI resolution error. Empty output cannot itself prove region selection, so the successor must retain the exact parser gate of one dut_ordinary INSTANCE.

successor_contract.minimum_ucli_delta: Insert exactly `power -gate_level all mda sv` before the existing DUT-scope selection; retain all reset/report ordering and the exact M2160 TB, parser, fixture, workload, single axis, and -debug_access+r compile surface.

verdict: M2178 correctly consumed its single budget and failed closed, but both raw SAIF files are empty activity containers: durations are correct while INSTANCE, NET, and activity-record counts are all zero. Functional execution and same-RTL controls rule out absent DUT activity. Installed official help plus sealed local successes isolate the missing UCLI gate-level SystemVerilog/MDA monitoring policy as the high-confidence cause. M2178 is permanently non-admitted and must not be retried; only fresh M2185 source authoring is allowed.
